jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM AI Product Leader
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Director to own the AI roadmap and strategy for our go-to-market organization: Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships. You will partner with our segments and RevOps to decide where AI creates the most value across the customer lifecycle, and work with Engineering to deliver it through a deliberate mix of best-in-class SaaS platforms (such as Salesforce, Gong) and custom-built solutions where off-the-shelf products fall short.

You will work with internal stakeholders to define the problems worth solving, prioritize ruthlessly, and measure adoption and business impact. You will be the accountable leader for how AI shows up in the way we sell, onboard, deliver, retain, and grow with customers and partners.

Key Responsibilities

GTM AI strategy and roadmap

Define and own a multi-year AI vision and a quarterly roadmap spanning Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships.
Identify, size, and prioritize AI use cases by revenue impact, productivity gain, cost to serve, and feasibility.
Establish clear principles for build vs. buy vs. configure, and make those calls transparently with business cases and total cost of ownership.
Align the GTM AI roadmap with company strategy, revenue targets, and the broader enterprise AI and data strategy.
Rationalize and govern overlapping tools and prevent AI sprawl across the GTM organization.
Run discovery, prototyping, pilots, and scale-up with clear success criteria and stage gates.

AI Across The GTM Functions

Sales: AI for prospecting and account research, lead and opportunity scoring, call and meeting intelligence, deal inspection and forecasting, proposal and RFP generation, pricing and quoting guidance, and rep coaching and ramp.
Customer Success: AI for health scoring and churn prediction, renewal and expansion signals, automated QBR and meeting prep, sentiment and call analysis, onboarding acceleration, and proactive risk alerts.
Professional Services: AI for scoping and estimation, project planning, knowledge retrieval, delivery acceleration, resource allocation, utilization, and margin improvement.
Partnerships: AI for partner identification and tiering, co-sell and pipeline insight, partner enablement, and ecosystem performance analytics.
Design cross-functional workflows that connect these motions, such as handoffs from sales to onboarding to delivery to renewal, so AI improves the whole customer lifecycle rather than isolated steps.

Adoption, change management, and value realization

Own adoption by partnering with Revenue Operations, enablement, and functional leaders on training, playbooks, and incentives so tools become part of daily work.
Define and report a KPI framework covering usage, productivity, pipeline and win rate, forecast accuracy, retention and expansion, services margin, and partner-sourced revenue.
Quantify ROI and report outcomes to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

Governance, data, and responsible AI

Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and IT to set guardrails for AI use with customer and partner data, including access controls, data residency, model usage policies, and auditability.
Ensure AI outputs are trustworthy and that humans remain appropriately in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
Partner with Data and Analytics on data quality, definitions, and a shared source of truth.

Leadership and operating model

Build and lead a team of product managers and business analysts, and influence a broader matrixed group of Engineering, Data, and GTM Operations partners.
Establish intake, prioritization, and governance processes so GTM leaders (CRO, CCO, Services, Partnerships) jointly steer the roadmap.
Act as the executive-level voice on GTM AI, internally and externally, including with vendors, analysts, and peer companies.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in product management, GTM operations or strategy, sales or revenue technology, or related roles, with 5+ years leading teams.
Demonstrated success owning a technology roadmap that serves revenue-generating teams, ideally across more than one of Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships.
Deep working knowledge of the GTM technology stack, including Salesforce and conversation intelligence tools like Gong, and how data flows between systems.
Hands-on experience delivering AI/ML or generative AI solutions into production, including a practical understanding of LLMs, agents, retrieval, prompt and workflow design, evaluation, and cost management.
Strong build-vs-buy judgment, vendor management experience, and comfort building business cases.
Proven ability to drive change and adoption among frontline revenue teams and senior business leaders.
Excellent executive communication, with the ability to translate between technical teams and business stakeholders.
Analytical rigor and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience as a sales, customer success, or services practitioner or leader, or in a hybrid GTM + product role.
Experience with Salesforce platform capabilities (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce or equivalent AI features), data cloud or warehouse integrations, and Gong or similar conversation intelligence tools.
Experience in a B2B, enterprise, or professional-services-oriented environment with long sales cycles and complex account structures.
Familiarity with partner ecosystems, co-sell motions, and channel programs.
Experience establishing AI governance and responsible-AI practices.

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $172,000 CAD - $222,000 CAD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

jobs.title: Senior Director, DevOps Product Management and Strategy
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

The Senior Director of DevOps Product Management and Strategy is a transformation-focused strategic leadership role that will shape RBC's future as a technology-led financial services leader. This position uniquely combines strategic vision, product management discipline, and organizational change leadership to drive the adoption of AI-enabled DevOps practices across our enterprise.

You will lead the multi-year transformation of how RBC develops and delivers technology, focusing on AI-integrated SDLC frameworks, harness engineering practices, and developer productivity optimization. This role requires both strategic thinking—setting 3-5 year vision and making critical technology investment decisions—and execution excellence, delivering innovative DevOps products and platforms that enable thousands of developers.

This is an opportunity to influence technology strategy at the highest levels while building and scaling proven approaches from pilot programs to enterprise-wide adoption, fundamentally changing how RBC builds software.

What will you do?

Strategic Leadership

Develop and own the 3-5 year DevOps transformation strategy aligned with enterprise technology and business objectives
Define the strategic vision for AI-enabled SDLC practices, determining which technologies, frameworks, and approaches RBC will standardize on, including harness engineering and specification-driven development
Lead strategic planning cycles including portfolio prioritization, investment allocation, and build-vs-buy decisions for DevOps capabilities
Conduct market intelligence and competitive analysis to position RBC as a technology leader and inform strategic technology choices
Partner with enterprise architecture and technology strategy teams to ensure DevOps strategy supports long-term business goals and enables business outcomes
Drive innovation strategy by establishing experimentation frameworks, pilot-to-scale pathways, and balancing innovation with operational excellence
Develop strategic partnerships with technology vendors, industry groups, and external advisors to accelerate capability development

Product Management & Execution

Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for DevOps platforms, tools, and services across the T&O organization
Lead cross-functional teams to deliver innovative DevOps products that enhance developer productivity and operational efficiency
Champion the integration of AI and automation technologies into DevOps and SDLC workflows to optimize processes and reduce manual effort
Collaborate with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and prioritize product features
Manage product lifecycle from conception through delivery, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer needs
Build and maintain relationships with internal customers, gathering feedback to continuously improve product offerings
Develop business cases and ROI models for DevOps investments, demonstrating value delivery to executive leadership

Leadership & Culture

Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the DevOps product organization
Stay current with DevOps industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to inform product strategy
Oversee budget and resource prioritization for DevOps product initiatives

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of product management or related leadership experience with 5+ years managing product teams and driving cross-functional initiatives
Proven experience leading enterprise transformation in complex organizations and developing multi-year technology strategies
Exceptional executive communication skills with ability to influence senior technology leaders and translate technical complexity into business value
Strong track record building strategic relationships with technology clients and presenting to executive audiences
Deep knowledge of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Understanding of AI/ML applications in DevOps and automation
Experience conducting market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and technology trend assessment
Strong business acumen with proven ability to build business cases, measure ROI, and make strategic decisions including portfolio rationalization and build-vs-buy analysis
Deep understanding of governance frameworks, security compliance, and risk management in regulated environments
Experience with agile product development methodologies
Ability to navigate complex organizational structures and influence without direct authority

Nice to Have

Master's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience with strategic planning frameworks (Wardley Mapping, OKRs, Technology Radar)
Management consulting background focused on technology strategy or transformation
Familiarity with AI development harnesses (Claude, Copilot, Windsurf) and harness engineering concepts
Experience with specification-driven development methodologies and scaling pilot programs to enterprise-wide adoption
Change management certification (Prosci, CCMP)
Product management (CSPO, CPM) or cloud platform certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Industry recognition as a thought leader in DevOps or platform engineering

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work
